Apple is expected to launch a brand new Home product in October, and based on leaked images discovered by MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris, we got an early look at the new product today.

New HomePod mini colours revealed in leaked images, fourth-generation Apple TV 4K retains existing design

According to MacRumors, Aaron Perris today uncovered evidence of three new products launching in October, including a brand new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K, and iPad mini.

Perris discovered images of the new HomePod mini in five colours from Apple's code. Three of the colours (green, pink, and blue) are brand new designs, alongside the existing white and black.

The new colour options can be seen in the following post:

Additionally, Perris also found images of the Apple TV 4K (fourth generation). As seen in the post below, the product appears to retain the design of the existing model:

No further details of the new products could be obtained from Apple's code, but the above findings further support the plan for an October launch.

What do you think of the new HomePod mini colours? Let us know in the comments section.
